title: ATT&CK coverage view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's attack-coverage view: the scope's MITRE ATT&CK coverage as of as_of against the pinned ATT&CK release. Modeled evidence (techniques the latest threat models cite) and weakness-derived candidates (finding categories through the pack's category map) are kept apart, never blended; observed coverage (confirmed validation chains) is not yet recorded. Includes an ATT&CK Navigator layer. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

as_of.description: The point in time the threat models and findings are read at: the filter's, else when the view was built.

attribution.description: MITRE's required attribution for ATT&CK content.

threats_with_techniques.description: Threats citing at least one live technique.

findings_mapped.description: Findings whose category maps to at least one technique.

techniques.description: Every technique with evidence, highest score first, then by technique id.

dropped.description: Technique ids threat models cite that are not live in the pinned release (revoked, deprecated or unknown), with how many threats cite each, most cited first. They count nowhere else.

navigator_layer.description: The coverage as an ATT&CK Navigator layer (layer format 4.5), MITRE's own format: the envelope is checked here, the layer's full schema is MITRE's. Scores follow the technique scores (1 weakness-derived candidate, 2 modeled, 3 observed).

technique_id.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique id (T1059, T1059.001).

score.description: The strongest evidence class: 1 weakness-derived candidate, 2 modeled, 3 observed (reserved: not yet produced).

technique.description: One technique's evidence: threats that model it and findings whose category implies it, counted apart.

name.description: The technique's name in the pinned release.

tactics.description: The tactics (kill-chain phases) the technique belongs to in the pinned release.

derived.description: Findings whose category implies the technique.
